rom.scope: GK104 BIOS clock-state table only; labels cross-checked with GTX 690. Stored frequencies do not establish live clocks, writable controls, or NVAPI domain IDs.

protocol: Four samples each at initial state, CUDA boost, verified ForcePstate P0 idle and CUDA load, then release. No voltage, fan, offset or ROM writes. Temporary P0 holds released in finally on both cores.

hold: P0 held; core 705 MHz, memory 3004 MHz (not a maximum-core lock)
release: P0 request released; automatic performance states restored
